reauth_confirm.description: The saved certificate no longer matches the ConnectBox. Continue only if you expect this change, for example after a gateway reset. The next step requires physical pairing confirmation on the same ConnectBox. Existing devices and entities are kept.

certificate_changed.message: The ConnectBox certificate has changed. Open the integration and confirm pairing again only if you expect the change.

summer_not_supported.message: Summer ventilation is not supported by the attached units.

summer_disabled.message: Enable the summer ventilation function in its settings or in the Zehnder app before starting an interval.

summer_duration_unavailable.message: The ConnectBox does not report a valid summer ventilation duration. Refresh the integration and check the app settings.

summer_mode_unavailable.message: Summer ventilation is only available in automatic or manual operation.

situation_unavailable.message: The current situation does not allow this change. Select At home or Away first.

summer_state_unavailable.message: The current summer ventilation state is unknown. Refresh the integration before trying again.

invalid_summer_configuration.message: Provide a valid summer ventilation function setting or duration.

invalid_summer_duration.message: Set the summer ventilation duration to a whole number of hours between 1 and 24.

summer_settings_unavailable.message: The summer ventilation settings are not available from the ConnectBox.

summer_running.message: Stop the summer ventilation interval before changing its settings.

invalid_level.message: Select a ventilation level between 0 and 4, or Auto when supported.

level_zero_unsupported.message: This ventilation unit does not support level 0. Use central standby instead.

sensor_board_unavailable.message: Auto requires a reported sensor board or an existing sensor-controlled room setting.

situation_not_configured.message: The room does not report a level setting for this situation.

situation_not_selectable.message: Only the situations At home and Away can be selected.

device_unavailable.message: The ventilation unit is no longer available. Refresh the integration.

room_unavailable.message: The room is no longer available. Refresh the integration.

filter_reset_unsupported.message: Filter reset is not supported for this ventilation unit.

filter_runtime_unavailable.message: The filter runtime is not available. Wait for a telemetry update before resetting the filter timer.

invalid_summer_role.message: Choose supply and exhaust, supply, or exhaust as the summer ventilation role.

summer_role_interval_active.message: The summer ventilation role cannot be changed while a summer ventilation interval is running.

summer_role_unsupported.message: Changing the summer ventilation role is not supported for this ventilation unit.

summer_role_unavailable.message: The ventilation unit does not currently report its summer ventilation role.

invalid_boost_duration.message: Choose a boost duration between 15 and 120 minutes in steps of 15.

boost_active.message: The boost duration cannot be changed while a boost is running.

boost_unsupported.message: The boost is not available for this room.

boost_mode_unavailable.message: A boost can only be started in automatic or manual mode.

boost_duration_unavailable.message: The room does not report a valid boost duration.

invalid_level_one_runtime.message: Choose 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes as the runtime of level 1 per hour.

level_one_runtime_unsupported.message: Changing the runtime of level 1 is not supported for this ventilation unit.

level_one_runtime_unavailable.message: The ventilation unit does not currently report the runtime of level 1.

command_rejected.message: The ConnectBox rejected the command. Check its operating state and settings in the app.

command_failed.message: The ConnectBox did not provide a valid confirmation of the change. Check the actual device state before trying again.

cannot_connect.message: Communication with the ConnectBox failed. Check the connection and the actual device state before trying again.
